scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*|npm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm, or npm only as the Hostinger bootstrap package manager" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build:workspace: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:auth:production && pnpm -r --if-present run build && node ./scripts/prepare-hostinger.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:auth:integration: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec vitest run src/routes/local-production-auth.test.ts src/routes/dev-auth.test.ts
